project.name: Murphy UI (PySide6 + QML) with Robot EtherNet/IP I/O
project.status: RobotComm CYCLIC working on 4 robots. UDP TX outputs confirmed working on all four. UDP RX inputs now parsing and mapping correctly but still need verification against real robot-side input bits.

python_robot_comm.config_file: robot_comm_config.json (written to CWD; dev run currently C:\py\murphy\robot_comm_config.json)

qml_engine.import_path: engine.addImportPath(<ui_qml runtime root>) so QML can `import RobotUI 1.0`

robot_comm.goal: Support up to 4 robots simultaneously with per-robot configurable IP/slot/in_words/out_words and show 32-bit indicators for inputs/outputs in the RobotComm UI page.

protocol_path: Parse O->T and T->O connection IDs
UDP RX demux by T->O conn_id
UDP TX cyclic to each robot using its O->T conn_id
current_state.concurrency: One worker thread per robot index (0-3); one shared UDP RX listener thread

wire_protocol_notes.word_packing: Inputs/Outputs are uint16 words; QML displays bits across the configured word arrays.
wire_protocol_notes.rx_demux_rule: T->O connection ID is at UDP offset 6 (not offset 8).
wire_protocol_notes.rx_io_payload_rule: Connected Data Item (0x00B1) payload begins with 2-byte sequence header; actual IO words start at payload[2:].
wire_protocol_notes.tx_packet: Encapsulation header + O->T conn_id + seq + Connected Data Item (0x00B1) containing 2-byte seq + 4-byte run/idle + output words; seq increments per TX.

debugging.where: Console prints plus per-robot QML log buffer (getDebugLog/getUdpCounts).
known_debug_findings: UDP packets mapped correctly via id6 hit; id8 is unrelated/variable.
Full packet dump confirmed 0x00B1 length=0x22 for 16-word IO: 2-byte seq + 32-byte IO.

slots_actions: setConfig(i, ip, port, slot, in_words, out_words)

qml_robot_comm_screen.purpose: Robot Communications page with robot selector buttons (1-4), CONFIG popup, status strip, and two 32-bit LED grids (Outputs left, Inputs right).

ui_layout.status_strip: State indicator + Last RX ms + Connect/Disconnect + Fault text

current_limits: Outputs confirmed working on all four robots at the protocol level; UI toggling/controls may still be pending depending on how outputs are being set.
Inputs are parsing but still need validation against known robot-side input bits.

next_tasks.task: Validate input bit mapping against robot-side produced assembly (pick 3-5 known ON bits on robot 2 and confirm in UI).
notes: Use robot-side forced bits or known status bits to confirm word/bit order.
Confirm endianness and bit numbering (bit0 = LSB of word0).

next_tasks.task: Add automatic reconnection per robot when watchdog detects RX timeout or socket/FO errors.
notes: Current watchdog stops worker on >2s no RX; needs retry loop with backoff.
Should re-run full TCP/RegisterSession/ForwardOpen, then resume UDP cyclic.
Should update state/fault text so UI shows 'reconnecting' instead of dead.
